name: Mother of Learning
description: Zorian is a teenage mage of humble birth and slightly above-average skill, attending his third year of education at Cyoria's magical academy. He is a driven and irritable young man, consumed by a desire to ensure his own future and free himself of the influence of his family, whom he resents for favoring his brothers over him. Consequently, he has no time for pointless distractions or paying attention to other people's problems. As it happens, time is something he is about to get plenty of. On the eve of the Cyoria's annual summer festival, he is killed and brought back to the beginning of the month, just before he was about to take a train to Cyoria. Suddenly trapped in a time loop with no clear end or exit, Zorian will have to look both within and without to unravel the mystery before him. And he does have to unravel it, for the time loop hadn't been made for his sake and dangers lurk…

name: Mother of Learning: The AU Chapters
description: This is a collection of what-if scenarios for my other story, Mother of Learning. Time related stories are full of interesting concepts, and alternate timelines are one of them. I've always been fascinated with AU stories, and I've decided to make a few chapters to celebrate getting Mother of Learning official published on Amazon. (By the way, if you are interested in that, you can find the Amazon link here.) And yes, this is basically the author making AU fanfiction for his own story. Don't take this too seriously: none of the stories here are canonical and are made purely for fun. If you aren't familiar with my main story, this will probably not make too much sense to you, but Mother of Learning is a story of a magic-using teenager stuck in a time loop, set in a fantasy world that is in the midst of a technological and magical revolution. If you like what you just read, go hop to the…

name: Mother of Learning: Abyss of Time, a Fanfiction Continuation.
description: This is a Fanfiction Continuation of nobody103's Alternate Universe story to his famous Mother of Learning series. I have asked for and recieved permission to write these fan fictions before embarking on this. This series will specifically focus on the Abyss of Time alternate universe story, proceeding from where that one left off. The 1st chapter is really more of a forward, as well as a link to the AU chapter by nobody103 that was supposed to be a one-shot until I decided to write a chapter 2 for it and then run with it from there. I do not own the intellectual property rights to the actual chapter 1 to this story, and therefore the link that I've included in my forward/version of chapter 1 is the only way you will have to see where this story actually starts.

name: Mother of Learning: Fanfic Sequel - "Tangled Web"
description: Mother of Learning fan made Sequel. Continues the main story, starting two months after the Summer Festival. Unrest is growing in Cyoria. Fear of mind magic is at an all time high, and Zorian Kazinski finds himself at the heart of it. He had helped create the problem, after all. With this new threat looming over him, he struggles to appear to be just an average student. Hiding his incredible magical abilities, serving as ambassador to the Aranea, dodging ongoing investigations into the invasion, and finally being able to make meaningful lasting relationships with the people around him. He had a lot on his plate, and that was ignoring his current financial problems. He had a lot of work to do. Better get started. I'm definitely not nobody103, but I did my best. Hope you enjoy. And watch out for spiders.

name: Mother of learning - The Great Unification War - A fanfiction sequel
description: This is a fanfic that continues one of my favorite story that is Mother of learning, the war that would follow after the events that occurred in the story. The main characters are still Zorian and Zach although there will be POVs of other characters in the story just like there were in MOL. And I would like to thank nobody103 for making Mother of Learning and the links of the Mother of learning and his worldbuilding blog that I will be making use to write this story are given in the author notes for the first chapter although I will try to make it so that reading the worldbuilding blog is not necessary for a reader to keep up with what is going on in the story. (this is my first time writing and English is not my first language so if you find any mistakes please feel free to comment and point it out but please be kind, thank you)

name: Zenith of Sorcery
description: After years of exile, Marcus is coming back home. A powerful mage with few equals, Marcus lives in a world full of monsters and powerful adepts, many of which have bad histories with him. But he has not come back to pursue vengeance or start a fight. All Marcus wants to do is reconnect with old friends, build himself a house, and maybe train a successor or two. Alas, the world didn’t stop just because Marcus went into exile, and not everyone is content to let go of old grievances. Strange things are happening in the world at large, too, hinting at a looming disaster of unknown nature. Still, where there is a will, there is a way. If nothing else, Marcus has a lot of magical power to throw at problems. +++ Zenith of Sorcery is set in its own original setting and isn’t related to Mother of Learning… beyond being written by the same person, of course. This is a more classical fantasy story…

name: Whispers of Quetzalcoatl [Fantasy Time Loop]
description: VOLUME 1&2 COMPLETE [200K+ WORDS] Hiatus until November 25th 😅 (I'm Sorry) "Your task is simple. Kill me!" In the First Age, True Dragons ruled Teotlcan. Then they vanished—erased by a single mage. Blessed by gods, angel of heaven, perhaps even a god himself, He walked the planes of reality and rewrote the world. Ten thousand years later, Aurelius dies in the most absurd way imaginable… and wakes with an impossible mission: kill the immortal mage. Through death, he becomes the Blessed of the Heretic, the Blasphemer, the Apocalypse. Shackled by a time loop and bound to the will of a suicidal god, Aurelius is forced onto a path of blood and eternity. His inexperience means little across decades, and his sanity even less in the face of infinite time. All he can do is endure the madness, slay angels, challenge gods. Under divine coercion, he must steal knowledge, seize power, and unravel…

name: The Life of a Joker.
description: The Joker is an interesting addition to a deck of cards. It has next to no use in most games, causing the Joker to be thrown away in most situations. However sometimes the Joker card is kept and is actually cherished by someone. This life of a Joker is the epitome of the life of Coyote Nakamura. He was born an Abnormal Godspawn, a creation of forcing a God to give a human their seed. He was bestowed the power of the Joker. This gives him the power of reversing time whenever he dies and sending his soul back to the desired time. However, it also curses Coyote to get into some of the worst situations possible. This forces Coyote to die hundreds of time until he discovers an answer and survives the situation. Luckily, Coyote has good guidance and decides to become a Dectective. He now uses his powers to stop criminals, terrorists, Demonspawn, and even other Godspawn. This is the story of…

name: Abyss of Time: Continuation (Revengeance)
description: This fanfiction is a continuation and re-imagining of nobody103's AU scenario of his webnovel Mother of Learning, both of which may be found on this platform. It is recommended to have read both the main story and the Abyss of Time AU chapter (which serves as an introduction) prior to reading this work. Zorian is in an repeating time loop of time loops. He has borne witness to the same month for hundreds of years, over which he has gained more magical power and knowledge than perhaps any other mortal in history. Overtaken by a nihilism induced by reshaping himself into something posthuman, and observing the total lack of moral consequences in his new reality, Zorian seeks new meaning in a world he is convinced cannot give it to him. But not everything is as it may seem. As the weight of years accumulate, ancient machinery of the world's long-forgotten mechanics whirl up, forces long…

name: The Looping MoronMagus (Mage Academy/Time Loop)
description: After being killed, a somewhat intellectually and empathically disadvantaged young mage wakes up just in time for the start of semester exams. He has been marked with the brand of time, cursed to return upon every death, until the calamity is prevented. If only he could only listen to his survival instinct long enough to find out that one was even coming. What to expect: -A real anti-hero Protagonist -A slow and realistic Weak to Strong -Character Development -Comedy Updates: Every Friday Book 1&2 already written Longer Note: If you're reading this you want to find out more about the story before giving it a try. It is partially inspired by Mother of Learning, but I'm taking a very different approach in terms of tropes. It's a bit of an experiment but as a reader I've been getting a bit bored by perfect protagonists, so here's my attempt at a story with a very flawed main character…

name: The Arcane Soul
description: When a lost soul awakens in the underworld without any memories of its previous life, it is offered a choice between eternal suffering and a second chance by a mysterious goddess. The soul decides to take a second chance and is reincarnated as a violet-colored elf in a magical metropolis. As the newly born elf navigates this fantastical world and its curious elven culture, he discovers the secrets of arcane and soul magic, from weaving mana to unlocking the mysteries of life and death. Join the elf on a journey of self-discovery as he learns to harness his newfound powers and unravel the secrets of the world and its inhabitants. Book 1 micro-synopsis: Slice of life, children, school, introduction to Ferilyn and magic, arcane magic. Book 2 micro-synopsis: Academic pursuit, adolescents, academy, advanced magic, soul magic, some action. Book 3 micro-synopsis: Political drama, adults…

name: How to beat a Time Looper when you can't loop yourself [Book 1 Complete]
description: Sid wanted a quiet life. That choice vanished when Earth was dragged into a divine war. Portals flared across the planet, leading to Kaliga, a primeval world in perpetual conflict. Earth wasn’t Kaliga’s ally. It was a colony. A pawn. Sid tried to walk away from the war, but a masked ambush killed him. He woke up in his younger body on the day he gained his first skill. The world matched his past, but everyone called him by a different name. His killer remained a mystery. Was someone rewriting history—or worse, his memory? Before the masked hand struck again, he had to uncover why his memories defied reality, and unmask his killer. He couldn’t shake the feeling that his murder was tied to the ancient war. What to Expect: [+] Mind-Mage Assassin MC [+] Skill Evolutions [+] Smart MC [+] Secret Organisation Building (later in the story) [+] Weak to Strong [+] No Harem [+] Inspired by Mother…

name: Science, Magic, and Mayhem [Reverse Portal, Progression, Urban Fantasy]
description: Some family you're born with, but the best are often found along the way. Adelfried, family man and leader of his village, studied magic to help and protect the people he loved. Naturally, he’s rewarded with an army at his doorstep and corruption too close to home. When betrayal rips him from his family, he's thrown into the strange world of suburban America where metal wagons roar, stiff winged birds cross the sky, and nothing is the same. Now hunted by a ruthless secret police force and a dangerous cult seeking the power he carries, he’s forced to crash on the Harper family’s couch, the one place he can remain hidden. He’ll explain everything to the Harpers once he learns English. Until then, paying in silver will have to suffice. What to expect: A reverse portal, urban fantasy in a modern setting Fast paced action grounded with slice of life moments Magic as a science fiction based…

name: Fantasy Short Stories Before Bed
description: Explore forgotten lands, uncover secret battles and enjoy the snippets of life brought to you by these short stories. Whether you are looking for a quick read before bed, waiting to get picked up from school or maybe you're on a lunch break at work, these stories are the ones for you! Author's Note: I intend to keep the setting as mostly fantasy based and then build stories on top of that, though the fantasy world will probably be different for every story. I enjoy writing and I am willing to take feedback. For the most part I just want to get the stories out there to gauge if there is any interest in my stuff at all really. I'd be up for creating stories that have "progression" in them too! My favourite book on the site is mother of learning after all! I encourage comments and would love to read what you guys think! I put a lot of love and effort into my work. ^_^ Also the cover image…

name: Unending year
description: Hello ! So this book is my submission for the Writathon 2025. It's a litrpg in the same world as my other novel 'Unending Soul', so fantasy world, medievalist vibes for the setting, and lot of magic. A System that give lot of abilities, and definitely work perfectly well with no problems whatsoever. For this Story we will be following the adventures of Justine, stuck in a Time loop during her first year at magic school. (Ok, I can imagine you rolling your eyes at my very original premise, but I'm not doing a 'mother of learning' or 'Year of apocalypse ' copy, it's a different story with the same basis :) ) I'm trying to do the writathon, so the quality and frequency of the chapter will be inconsistent, especially since I'm starting late, so I will do a minimal spell check on the chapters before publishing and will be putting them up as fast as I write them. When it's over (and I have…

name: Splashdown Barsoom
description: Walt D. Odell was born in the belt. Like many other Jovean workers, he does 'the long haul'. Moving the most valuable substance in Sol... Water. It isn't a bad life. Pays well. AI companionship. Excellent healthcare benefits. After 100000 years struggling in the mud the human race got its shit together. Everything was going great until Walt tries to make a splashdown in the Heinlein Sea. Routine drop and some R&R planned to build up some muscle mass before going back into microgravity. But the great domed cities of Promethei Terra aren't there. He can't establish contact with the belt or Earth. And there's green along the Lowell Canals? ----- Hello, I am a professional copywriter who has mainly worked in soul-crushing corporate positions. Inside sales operations, CRM database administration, and email lead gen... yuck. And I read terrible, escapest sci-fi. Sometimes to get through the…

name: 4D Chess Saga
description: CHECKMATE Have you played chess before? Hard right. Now vs a opponent that can go back in time to try again if they lose and you would be none the wiser. Unbeatable. Unwinnable. Meet your opponent in this theoretical game, Zifire. She can do exactly that. A orphan from Runshard Capital, she learnt to avoid detection from the Church to live. Swiping and stealing to live. All changes when she finally gets caught(betrayed). Zifire tricks the guard to have a opportunity to take a Sagatic Crystal. Blessed by the Primordial of Time, with the ability to create and move around Timelines, Zifire makes a goal to take doen the Church, go on a holiday resort with excellent massages, and become the Dictator of a City both legally and criminally(For the fun). Life sure does fly by. Only if you could ride it too. [}{][}{][}{][}{] Inspired by: Mother of Learning, The Perfect Run, He Wo Fights With…

name: Purpose; Nothing (Dark Fantasy Progression Apocalypse)
description: Purpose; a dark fantasy webserial written by Kaysin, starting in late 2023. Updates come every Monday and Thursday, with bonus character chapters for milestones. Charlotte Haskell's always been a survivor, yet after an unfortunately timed date turns into the apocalypse, she's thrust in a world of fantasy where Dragon's and Demon's aren't just magical, they're true monsters. Left to survive in this new world of Magic, Charlotte has to find her family, protect those around her, stumble through the steps into adulthood, and survive the onslaught from another world, all while learning about her new powers, and combating the demonic forces that threaten to destroy mankind. Purpose; isn't for the faint of heart, and touches on dark theme's and death more than your average serial. Characters die, people are various shades of greyed out morality, and the world is brutal and unrelenting. The…

name: Eva & The Lightning King
description: In the heart of a land torn apart by war, a forbidden spell echoes through the night: "Come, Death. Come to me." But when the exiled archmage behind it finds herself face to face with the king she once doomed, Maeva Sininen knows that her desperate quest for redemption will lead her beyond Death. Anathas, thrust into kingship after the tragic demise of his father and brothers, never expected to cross paths with a woman alone in the woods. Struggling to launch a campaign against his father's killers, Nath pledges to aid "Eva," unaware of her identity or the role she played in his family's downfall. As their fates intertwine, Nath and Maeva embark on a journey fraught with danger and discovery. With each step, they inch closer to confronting their shared past and the elusive enemy known as the Winze. But amidst the chaos of war and magic, could love possibly bloom? Prepare for a…

name: The Sinner's Retrograde
description: Sable Voss Lucthilde grew up in the Dredge. That means flooded tunnels, poisoned air, and a Rain that kills thirty-five thousand people every cycle while the people above count the bodies and call it policy. When the Rain finally gives him a Grace, it’s this: genuine regret rewinds time by sixty seconds. Not fire. Not strength. Just enough rope to hang himself with twice. But Sable is patient. And he’s been writing down the names of everyone who deserves to die for a very long time. The bird on his shoulder used to be a robin. It’s something else now. The boy beside him blows things up with his feet and refuses to leave. The girl he carried out of the Dredge is eight years old and learning what it means to refuse to be eaten. And somewhere above all of them, five Houses are voting on whether people like Sable get to exist. They should have killed him when they had the chance. CONTENT…
